messages:
maria: opened a quick PR to update tokenizer + profile for orion-6b. would appreciate a fast eyeball before we cut the dedicated pool tomorrow morning. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/412 — CI green but want confirmation on special-token handling and compatibility with kv-cache prefixing.

james: on it, starting a review now. main thing i'm checking is whether vocab_override could break fallback to the 4bit quantized variant.

li: quick note — the token counts in the eval harness looked stable, but i saw one example where leading spaces ended up as separate tokens. can you paste the tokenizer config here?

maria: config snippet below, added a small override for <pad> and <mask> to align with the upstream weights:
```
{
  "type": "byte-level-bpe",
  "vocab_size": 50280,
  "special_tokens": {"pad": "<pad>", "eos": "</s>", "mask": "<mask>"},
  "vocab_override": ["<pad>", "<mask>"],
  "normalizer": "nfkc"
}
```

kyle: looks fine to me. li — i can add a unit that reproduces the leading-space case if you want a blocking test.

li: please add it, thanks. also can we add a short comment explaining why vocab_override is needed (compat with upstream tokenizer.json). saves future confusion.

maria: pushed a follow-up commit with a whitespace test + a brief comment in the config. pinging @james @li for final approvals.

ci-bot: CI passed — unit tests: 2153 passed, 2 skipped; integration: 14/14 passed. docker image build succeeded.

james: reviewed and left one tiny nit (typo in the comment). but not blocking, approving after that fix.

li: LGTM, tests cover the edge-case. approved.

maria: thanks all — merging in ~10m unless anyone objects :thumbsup:

kyle: no objections, thanks!
